Scope: 111 retained entries from the original catalog; 101 distinct Workshop items

Issues.Finding: Author explicitly says multiplayer is not fully implemented or tested; the ModId suffix does not establish multiplayer reliability.
Issues.Action: Exclude from default multiplayer profile; retain mapping for opt-in use.

Issues.Finding: Author states physical scene generation is single-player only, multiplayer dedicated-server testing is pending, and tested build is 42.15.2 with minimum 42.13.
Issues.Action: Exclude from conservative default multiplayer profile; do not substitute an unofficial fork.

Issues.Finding: Dynamic Vehicle Snow author now recommends Immersive Snow. Both provide snow visuals on vanilla vehicles; no explicit author hard incompatibility was found.
Issues.Action: Prefer ImmersiveSnow and exclude DynamicVehicleSnow as a redundancy recommendation, not a confirmed conflict.

Issues.Finding: Author supports 42.20+ single player and dedicated multiplayer, with KI5 support, but lists vehicle snow flickering at some angles as a known issue.
Issues.Action: Test visual behavior; do not claim zero errors.

Issues.Finding: Author's published range ends at 42.20.4, although the mod states support for single player and dedicated multiplayer. 42.21.0 is not explicitly certified on the page.
Issues.Action: Retain pending downloaded versionMin/versionMax checks and multiplayer beehive test.

Issues.Finding: Published support range ends at 42.20.x; no explicit author claim for exact 42.21.0 was found.
Issues.Action: Retain pending downloaded metadata check and runtime crafting test.

Issues.Finding: Author describes multiplayer as a work in progress that mostly works. Build 42.20+ support does not prove every feature is reliable in 42.21 multiplayer.
Issues.Action: Keep with an explicit limitation and test overlapping bandage, flashlight and magazine features.

Issues.Finding: Vanilla Outfits author says Open Jackets does not yet support its new items/textures; opening or rolling affected clothing may restore vanilla textures. Tomb's body is compatible with some female clothing clipping.
Issues.Action: Keep both with clothing visual test; do not label a complete hard conflict.

Issues.Finding: Open Jackets author requires Fluffy Hair for opened hoodies. Other jacket features do not require that optional hairstyle pack.
Issues.Action: If FH is disabled, explain opened hoodies are unavailable rather than adding FH as a universal hard requirement.

Issues.Finding: Author requires matching 512x512 body textures and warns not to use HD details with vanilla 256 textures. TombBody alone changes models and does not supply the missing texture pack.
Issues.Action: Keep SPNCCDetailsHD excluded when using vanilla 256 textures. Restart clients after body retexture changes.

Issues.Finding: Author requires every multiplayer player to enable the framework and body retextures in the main menu before joining; texture size must match installed body textures.
Issues.Action: Install client main-menu preset, close/restart game after changes, and document graphics texture requirement for the chosen variant.

Issues.Finding: Clean Hotbar author links Minimal Hotbar for optional auto-hide; the pair should not be excluded merely because both concern the hotbar.
Issues.Action: Keep both and load CleanHotBar near the end as its author recommends.

Issues.Finding: Current CleanUI author lists Better Containers (Workshop 3586216562) as tested compatible. Better Containers author separately explains multiplayer world-loot nested containers have a networking limitation; player-inventory nesting is supported.
Issues.Action: Keep pair; report nesting limitation. Do not turn earlier uncertain comments into a confirmed conflict.

Issues.Finding: Author tested multiplayer and targets 42.20/42.21 but explicitly had not tried a dedicated server.
Issues.Action: Retain with dedicated-server barricade interaction test.

Issues.Finding: Immersive Cars applies recurring decay and simulated initial damage; Time Decreases Car Condition damages parts when vehicles first spawn in unexplored areas. Both can reduce initial condition; no author confirmed hard conflict was found.
Issues.Action: Keep with sandbox tuning and vehicle-condition test rather than hard incompatibility.

Issues.Finding: Requested Workshop item 2696986935 is the original with a December 2024 update. A separate continuation fork 3529472651 advertises Build 42 multiplayer, but no explicit exact 42.21 author support for the original was found.
Issues.Action: Keep requested mapping unless transparently replacing it; do not silently rewrite to the continuation fork.

Issues.Finding: Requested original has no current explicit exact 42.21 author support. Users refer to a separate 42.20 fork; user comments alone do not verify a safe replacement.
Issues.Action: Keep requested mapping and test washer behavior; do not silently substitute forks.

Issues.Finding: Original exclusion referred to TacHoldFork, which is no longer in the new requested list. No current author-supported reason to retain that old exclusion was found.
Issues.Action: Re-enable Buttstroke and remove obsolete TacHold conflicts; exact 42.21 animation behavior still needs runtime test.

Issues.Finding: Page contains a workaround about LuaChecksum from older multiplayer versions. That is not a reason to automatically disable checksums on the current server.
Issues.Action: Leave checksum protection enabled and validate actual installed files.

Issues.Finding: Author says the server layout design is multiplayer ready but not yet tested on a server; dedicated thrown-car spill has a fallback. KI5 cars were used in visual testing, with possible missing panels.
Issues.Action: Exclude under the same conservative author-untested multiplayer rule.

Issues.Finding: Author tested exact 42.21 in single player and only startup on in-game host with one player; animation visibility to other players is unknown. Fancy Handwork 42.21 requires a separate unofficial fix if enabled.
Issues.Action: Exclude under conservative author-untested multiplayer rule; do not silently add an unofficial patch.

Issues.Finding: Author explicitly advises against adding this to an existing world because existing vehicle doors, hoods and trunks will open. Opening visuals apply only to animated vehicles.
Issues.Action: Use a fresh test world first; show the author requirement in setup actions.

Issues.Finding: Mini Health Panel author says its one-time update notice may not be dismissible while a UI modification such as NeatUI Framework is enabled.
Issues.Action: If the notice cannot close, temporarily disable UI mods, dismiss it once, restore the preset and restart.

Issues.Finding: Author reports vanilla Build 42.20 map-read history does not persist after reconnect; maps can appear unread again.
Issues.Action: Disable map status markers if affected; do not treat every read marker as fully persistent.

Issues.Finding: Author says notes are generated on each client, so different players can see different text for the same note.
Issues.Action: Keep with documented unsynchronized note-text limitation.

Issues.Finding: Author uses partial ID/category matching and explicitly warns weights of other mods' items may also be affected.
Issues.Action: Test gun/food/container carrying weights rather than treating its changes as limited to vanilla items.

Issues.Finding: Better Auto Mechanics author explicitly lists Vehicle Repair Overhaul and KI5 as compatible.
Issues.Action: Keep pair; load repair base after vehicles as its author requests.

MetadataSources.Finding: Sorter author reads custom loadAfter/loadBefore/incompatibleMods/loadFirst/loadLast from common/mod.info; version mod.info native fields are loadModAfter/loadModBefore/incompatible. Do not confuse common with legacy Build 41 root mod.info.
MetadataSources.Recommendation: Read version game metadata and separately include common sorting extensions; recognize both key families without treating unsupported category sorting as a global first/last rule.

MetadataSources.Finding: User report on official forum concerns backslash-prefixed loadAfter metadata and server order, not proof of required backslashes in Mods=; its Mods= example uses plain IDs.
MetadataSources.Recommendation: Do not cite this as official mandatory Mods= format or proof of exact 42.21 server ordering.

MetadataSources.Finding: Current 42.21-compatible author's server example uses Mods=NeatUI_Framework;CleanUI.
MetadataSources.Recommendation: Plain IDs have current author support; leading-backslash server formatting has other empirical reports but is not established here as the sole official syntax.

MetadataSources.Finding: Guide author's direct 42.20 code inspection reports ChooseGameInfo.readModInfoAux prefers version/mod.info and uses common/mod.info only as a fallback. Common and version game metadata therefore should not be merged wholesale.
MetadataSources.Recommendation: Use selected version id/require/version limits, or common metadata only if no version mod.info exists; include common custom sorter keys separately.

ReviewLimitations: Workshop author descriptions are compatibility evidence, not execution tests.
Not every retained item explicitly certifies exact 42.21.0 or dedicated multiplayer.
Steam's scraped generic removed/incompatible banner appears on many valid items and was not used as a real mod removal verdict.
No Windows Steam client/server gameplay test was performed in this macOS environment.

PotentialReplacement.Finding: Maintainer states Build 42 multiplayer support and author tested local MP on August 26. Original claims B41/B42 but was last updated December 2024 and has no exact 42.21 certification.
PotentialReplacement.Recommendation: A transparent replacement may be justified by the requested corrected 42.21 profile; retain original source in the compatibility report and avoid subscribing both identical ModId sources.

PotentialLaundryReplacement.Finding: Fork author explicitly describes a 42.20 dirtiness/API fix. Exact ID is also present in cached latest page but older live view only has a user-provided ID comment. No author exact 42.21 dedicated multiplayer assurance or public metadata was verified.
PotentialLaundryReplacement.Recommendation: Conservative exclusion of the original is preferable until downloaded metadata and multiplayer testing can establish the fork. Do not label original B41-only, since author tags include B42.
